reason: This plugin is primarily a chat workflow automation utility: it extends DeepSeek Harness web sessions with a separate slash-command group for steering, new-session control, and structured follow-up actions (skill/docs), based on the README command list and settings behavior.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 web 插件，用于在聊天输入框中新增独立斜杠命令组，支持 /steer、/new、/skill、/docs，并可在设置中配置自定义 /steer 快捷子命令。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a dedicated slash-command group in chat input, including /steer, /new, /skill, and /docs, with optional custom /steer shortcuts via settings.

capabilities: Adds a dedicated slash-command group in the DeepSeek Harness chat interface
Provides commands to steer the next model step, open new sessions, and trigger skill/docs-oriented follow-up actions
Allows configuring custom shortcut aliases for steer-style commands in plugin settings

reasons.code: README documents the core commands " /steer", "/new", "/skill", and "/docs" and their behaviors (steering next step, new blank conversation, save output as skill, write reason/plan to docs).
README states plugin settings expose custom short names for common /steer content, indicating configurable user-facing command actions.
Package metadata describes the project as an "Ultra Slash" plugin for DeepSeek Harness with web client integration and injected UI/runtime modules.
